title: Glue Job Component Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Glue Job component following the Platform Component API contract and AWS MCP schema guidelines.

jobName.description: Override the generated job name. Defaults to {serviceName}-{componentName}.

description.description: Human-readable description of the Glue job.

glueVersion.description: Glue version to target for the job runtime.

roleArn.description: Optional execution role ARN. If omitted the component will create a role.

scriptLocation.description: S3 URI of the Glue job script.

connections.description: Optional Glue connections to attach to the job.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Maximum number of concurrent job runs allowed.

maxRetries.description: Number of retries Glue should attempt for failed runs.

timeout.description: Maximum job run time in minutes.

notifyDelayAfter.description: Number of minutes to wait before sending delay notifications.

maxConcurrentRuns.description: Maximum number of concurrent runs Glue should permit.

defaultArguments.description: Arguments merged with the platform defaults. Values must be strings.

nonOverridableArguments.description: Arguments that cannot be overridden by job invocation parameters.

logging.description: Log group configuration for Glue job outputs.

monitoring.description: Monitoring and alarm thresholds for the Glue job.

tags.description: Additional user-defined tags merged with platform standard tags.

pythonVersion.description: Python runtime version to execute the job script.

scriptArguments.description: Command-line arguments passed to the Glue job script.

workerType.description: Glue worker type used for the job.

numberOfWorkers.description: Number of Glue workers to provision.

id.description: Identifier for the log group (used in construct handles).

enabled.description: Whether this log group should be created.

logGroupSuffix.description: Suffix appended to the generated log group name.

removalPolicy.description: Removal policy applied to the log group.

groups.description: Collection of log groups to create for the job.

enabled.description: Whether monitoring and alarms are enabled.

threshold.description: Number of failed tasks needed to trigger the alarm.

evaluationPeriods.description: Number of periods over which data is compared to the threshold.

thresholdMs.description: Glue job duration threshold in milliseconds.

evaluationPeriods.description: Number of periods over which data is compared to the threshold.

kmsKeyArn.description: ARN of an existing KMS key to use for encryption.

createCustomerManagedKey.description: Whether to create a customer managed key when no ARN is provided.

removalPolicy.description: Removal policy for the managed KMS key.

securityConfigurationName.description: Name of an existing Glue security configuration.
